1.text: Gusenga kwa Dawidi.Uwiteka, umva iby'ukuri byanjye,Tyariza ugutwi gutaka kwanjye,Tegera ugutwi gusenga kwanjye,Kudaturuka mu minwa iryarya.

2.text: Urubanza rwanjye ruturuke imbere yawe,Amaso yawe arebe ibitunganye.

3.text: Wagerageje umutima wanjye,wangendereye nijoro.Warantase ntiwambonana umugambi mubi,Namaramaje kudacumuza ururimi rwanjye.

4.text: Ku by'imirimo y'abantu,kwitondera ijambo ry'iminwa yawe,Ni ko kumpa kwirinda inzira z'abanyarugomo.

5.text: Intambwe zanjye zikomerera mu nzira zawe,Ibirenge byanjye ntibinyerera.

6.text: Mana, ndakwambaje kuko uri bunsubize,Ntegera ugutwi wumve ibyo mvuga.

7.text: Erekana imbabazi zawe zitangaza,Wowe ukiza abakwiringira,Ababahagurukira ubakirishe ukuboko kwawe kw'iburyo.

8.text: Undinde nk'imboni y'ijisho,Umpishe mu gicucu cy'amababa yawe.

9.text: Umpishe abanyabyaha banyaga,Ni bo banzi banjye bashaka kunyica bangose.

10.text: Bakinze imitima yabo,Akanwa kabo bakavugisha iby'ubwibone.

11.text: None bagose intambwe zacu,Baduhangiye amaso kudutsinda hasi.

12.text: Ahwanye n'intare ifite ipfa ry'icyo yafata,Nk'umugunzu w'intare wubikirira mu bico.

13.text: Uwiteka haguruka,Umuhagarare imbere umutsinde hasi.Ukize umutima wanjye umunyabyaha,uwukirishe inkota yawe.

14.text: Uwiteka uwukize abantu,uwukirishe ukuboko kwawe.Ni bo bantu b'isi,Bafite umugabane wabo muri ubu bugingo.Inda zabo uzihaze ubutunzi bwawe,Bahāge abana b'abahungu,Ibintu byabo bisigare babisigire impinja zabo.

15.text: Jyeweho nzareba mu maso hawe nkiranuka,Mu ikanguka ryanjye nzahaga ishusho yawe.
